parameters.name: AdjustmentType
parameters.description:
The adjustment method of the scaling rule. This parameter is applicable to simple scaling rules and step scaling rules, and is required in these cases. Valid values:

- QuantityChangeInCapacity: adds or removes the specified number of ECS instances.
- PercentChangeInCapacity: adds or removes the specified percentage of ECS instances.
- TotalCapacity: adjusts the number of ECS instances in the current scaling group to the specified number.

parameters.name: AdjustmentValue
parameters.description:
The adjustment value of the scaling rule. This parameter is applicable to simple scaling rules and step scaling rules, and is required in these cases. The number of ECS instances adjusted in a single scaling activity cannot exceed 1,000. Valid values for different adjustment methods:
- QuantityChangeInCapacity: -1000 to 1000.
- PercentChangeInCapacity: -100 to 10000.
- TotalCapacity: 0 to 2000.

parameters.name: AlarmDimension
parameters.description: The dimension information associated with the metric. This parameter is applicable to target tracking scaling rules. Set this parameter when the metric requires additional dimension information. For example, the `LoadBalancerRealServerAverageQps` metric requires the `rulePool` dimension information.

sub_parameters.name: DimensionKey
sub_parameters.description: The key of the dimension associated with the metric.

sub_parameters.name: DimensionValue
sub_parameters.description: The value of the dimension associated with the metric.

parameters.name: AlarmOptions
parameters.description: The alert attribute definitions.

parameters.name: Cooldown
parameters.description:
The cooldown period of the scaling rule. This parameter is applicable only to simple scaling rules. Valid values: 0 to 86400. Unit: seconds.

Default value: empty.

parameters.name: DisableScaleIn
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to disable scale-in. This parameter is applicable only to target tracking scaling rules.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: EstimatedInstanceWarmup
parameters.description:
The warm-up period of instances. This parameter is applicable to target tracking scaling rules and step scaling rules. ECS instances in the warm-up state are added to the scaling group as normal but do not report monitoring data to CloudMonitor during the warm-up period.
> When dynamically calculating the number of ECS instances to scale, instances in the warm-up state are not counted as part of the existing instance count.
          
Valid values: 0 to 86400. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 300.

parameters.name: HybridMetrics
parameters.description: The Hybrid Cloud Monitoring metric settings. For information about how to configure them, see [Use formula-based custom target tracking rules](~~2852162~~).

sub_parameters.name: Dimensions
sub_parameters.description: The metric dimensions. Used to specify the resources monitored by the metric.

sub_parameters.name: Expression
sub_parameters.description:
The metric expression for multiple Hybrid Cloud Monitoring metrics. The calculation result of the expression is used to trigger scaling.

The expression must conform to the Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) specification, and only the operators `+ - * /` are supported.

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description: The reference ID of the metric in the metric expression.

sub_parameters.name: MetricName
sub_parameters.description: The metric name in the Hybrid Cloud Monitoring metric namespace.

sub_parameters.name: Statistic
sub_parameters.description:
The statistical method of the metric. Valid values:
- Average: the average of all data points within the specified period.
- Minimum: the minimum value of all data points within the specified period.
- Maximum: the maximum value of all data points within the specified period.

parameters.name: HybridMonitorNamespace
parameters.description:
The ID of the Hybrid Cloud Monitoring metric namespace.

To manage metric namespaces, see [Manage metric namespaces](~~217606~~).

parameters.name: InitialMaxSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of instances in the scaling group. This parameter is used in combination with PredictiveValueBehavior.

Default value: the maximum number of instances in the scaling group (the value of MaxSize).

parameters.name: MetricName
parameters.description:
The predefined metric. This parameter is applicable to target tracking scaling rules and predictive scaling rules, and is required in these cases.


Valid values for target tracking scaling rules: 
- CpuUtilizationAgent: (Agent) CPU utilization (recommended).
- MemoryUtilization: (Agent) memory utilization (recommended).
- CpuUtilization: (ECS) average CPU utilization.
- IntranetTx: (ECS) average outbound traffic over the internal network.
- IntranetRx: (ECS) average inbound traffic over the internal network.
- VpcInternetTx: (ECS) average outbound traffic over the public network.
- VpcInternetRx: (ECS) average inbound traffic over the public network.
- LoadBalancerRealServerAverageQps: (ALB) average QPS per server in the server group.

Valid values for predictive scaling rules: 
- CpuUtilization: (ECS) average CPU utilization.
- IntranetRx: (ECS) average inbound traffic over the internal network.
- IntranetTx: (ECS) average outbound traffic over the internal network.

For more information, see [System monitoring alert tasks](~~74854~~).

parameters.name: MetricType
parameters.description:
The type of the metric. Valid values:

- system: uses CloudMonitor system metrics.
- custom: uses custom metrics reported to CloudMonitor.
- hybrid: uses Hybrid Cloud Monitoring metrics.

parameters.name: MinAdjustmentMagnitude
parameters.description: The minimum number of instances to adjust in a scaling rule. This parameter takes effect only when the scaling rule type is `SimpleScalingRule` or `StepScalingRule`, and `AdjustmentType` is set to `PercentChangeInCapacity`.

parameters.name: PredictiveScalingMode
parameters.description:
The mode of the predictive scaling rule. Valid values:

- PredictAndScale: generates prediction results and creates prediction tasks.
- PredictOnly: generates prediction results but does not create prediction tasks.

Default value: PredictAndScale.

parameters.name: PredictiveTaskBufferTime
parameters.description:
Prediction tasks automatically created by a predictive scaling rule are executed at the start of each hour by default. You can set a pre-launch time to execute prediction tasks in advance to prepare resources ahead of time. Valid values: 0 to 60. Unit: minutes.

Default value: 0.

parameters.name: PredictiveValueBehavior
parameters.description:
The method used to process the maximum value for the predictive scaling rule. Valid values:

- MaxOverridePredictiveValue: the initial maximum value overrides the predicted value. When the predicted value is greater than the initial maximum value, the maximum value of the prediction task uses the initial maximum value.
- PredictiveValueOverrideMax: the predicted value overrides the initial maximum value. When the predicted value is greater than the initial maximum value, the maximum value of the prediction task uses the predicted value.
- PredictiveValueOverrideMaxWithBuffer: the predicted value is increased by a specified ratio. The predicted value is increased based on the PredictiveValueBuffer ratio. When the increased value is greater than the initial maximum value, the increased value is used.

Default value: MaxOverridePredictiveValue.

parameters.name: PredictiveValueBuffer
parameters.description:
This parameter takes effect only when `PredictiveValueBehavior` is set to `PredictiveValueOverrideMaxWithBuffer`. The predicted value is increased by the specified ratio. When the increased value is greater than the initial maximum value, the increased value is used. Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 0.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group.

parameters.name: ScaleInEvaluationCount
parameters.description:
After a target tracking scaling rule is created, an alert task is automatically created. This parameter specifies the number of consecutive times that the threshold condition must be met before the corresponding scale-in alert task triggers an alert.

Default value: 15.

parameters.name: ScaleOutEvaluationCount
parameters.description:
After a target tracking scaling rule is created, an alert task is automatically created. This parameter specifies the number of consecutive times that the threshold condition must be met before the corresponding scale-out alert task triggers an alert.

Default value: 3.

parameters.name: ScalingGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group to which the scaling rule belongs.

parameters.name: ScalingRuleName
parameters.description:
The name of the scaling rule. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and start with a digit, letter, or Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), or periods (.).

The scaling rule name must be unique within a scaling group under the same user account in the same region.

>If this parameter is not specified, the default value is the value of ScalingRuleId.

parameters.name: ScalingRuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the scaling rule. Valid values:

- SimpleScalingRule: simple scaling rule. Adjusts the number of ECS or ECI instances based on the adjustment method (AdjustmentType) and adjustment value (AdjustmentValue).
- TargetTrackingScalingRule: target tracking scaling rule. Dynamically calculates the number of ECS or ECI instances to scale based on the predefined metric (MetricName) and attempts to keep the metric value close to the target value (TargetValue).
- StepScalingRule: step scaling rule. Provides a step-based scaling method based on thresholds and metric values.
- PredictiveScalingRule: predictive scaling rule. Uses machine learning to analyze the historical monitoring data of a scaling group, predict future metric values, and supports automatically creating scheduled tasks to set scaling group boundaries.

Default value: SimpleScalingRule.

parameters.name: StepAdjustment
parameters.description: The collection of instance scaling information corresponding to step adjustments.

sub_parameters.name: MetricIntervalLowerBound
sub_parameters.description: The lower boundary of a step adjustment. This parameter is applicable only to step scaling rules. Valid values: -9.999999E18 to 9.999999E18.

sub_parameters.name: MetricIntervalUpperBound
sub_parameters.description: The upper boundary of a step adjustment. This parameter is applicable only to step scaling rules. Valid values: -9.999999E18 to 9.999999E18.

sub_parameters.name: ScalingAdjustment
sub_parameters.description: The number of instances to scale corresponding to a step adjustment. This parameter is applicable only to step scaling rules.

parameters.name: TargetValue
parameters.description: The target value. This parameter is applicable to target tracking scaling rules and predictive scaling rules, and is required in these cases. The TargetValue can have up to three decimal places and must be greater than 0.
